boot.construction: preregistered in P3-PREREGISTRATION.md (boot-disk section); executed only at P3; resulting disk image hash asserted against the preregistered expectation there
boot.esp_layout: GPT disk image; exactly one EFI System Partition (FAT32); exactly one EFI application at /EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI, which is the signed UKI; no other boot path

basis: GCP free tier: one non-preemptible e2-micro instance-month per month in us-west1/us-central1/us-east1
30 GB-month standard persistent disk per month
1 GB network egress from North America per month
cost.sizing_note: 7 pd-standard disks at the 10 GB minimum, held for a minutes-scale ceremony, are about 0.25 GB-month, far inside the 30 GB-month free tier; e2-micro usage stays inside the instance-month; evidence egress stays far under 1 GB
cost.verification: verified against live pricing and quota only at P3 pre-execution; any nonzero projected cost is a hard stop

network.offline_inputs_source: pre-staged on v3-reviewed-input, built offline and hash-pinned (offline-input-pins.v1.json)
network.phase_rule: network is used only for provisioning API calls and staging uploads; after the offline inputs exist on v3-reviewed-input, NETWORK_DENIED for the ceremony (no external IP, deny-all firewall)

prohibited: any production secret or private key material
certificate placement into any local trust store
any physical target mutation before owner authorization through the reviewer

rollback.verification: gcloud list commands return empty for every created resource; exact commands in P3-PREREGISTRATION.md
